numericalProtocol.controls: Reuse eligible 93e8f0afe125b1ea8e87f4b8336664dd390c5b3a controls under unchanged method/environment. Time passing or integrated139 alone does not require replacement controls.

numericalProtocol.traffic: Preserve all six saved source hashes, original assertions, T11 populations12→20/held turns1→3/burst16 and complete ten-operation cycles until current commits reach actual B×10. Preserve T12 factor2, populations and four profiles. No fixed 87/874 endpoint filter.
numericalProtocol.eligibility: Fresh outputs/colonies, serial local runs, no overlapping compute and five-second pre/post unrelated CPU <=0.25 core. Retain invalid/interrupted attempts; slowness alone never excludes a run.

numericalProtocol.labels: Admission and storage only; bookkeeping, not capacity, provider, executor, delivery, power-loss or SLA evidence.
numericalProtocol.failure: Retain failures and stop. No sixth slice, further mechanism, larger cache, snapshot, threshold relaxation or traffic reduction follows automatically.
